turns.text: Our objection handling process, it's clarify, discuss, diffuse. We are not getting into objection handling mode, pitching features and benefits, trying to convince the client that whatever he's saying is wrong because we're going to the same as our mom or dad or husband or wife is trying to convince us to do something, saying, oh, you have to definitely do that. What we feel, like we don't want to do it. We just want to resist.
